fields.label: Safe
fields.description: The safe that holds this bag.

fields.label: Pos Profile
fields.description: The register this bag belongs to.

fields.label: Bag seal / ID
fields.description: Written on the physical bag. Each bag has its own seal; labels and handover sheets show it.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: Float: waits in the safe to start a drawer. Takings: sent to the bank.

fields.label: State
fields.options:
Available
Unverified
Disputed
Issued
In Transit
Deposited
Unpacked
Transferred
fields.description: Where the bag is now. It changes only through the bag actions above.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Cash sealed in the bag, from the preparer's count.

fields.label: Prepared By
fields.description: Who counted and sealed the bag.

fields.label: Verified By
fields.description: Who recounted the sealed bag independently. Empty means nobody has.

fields.label: Received By
fields.description: The cashier who received the bag into a drawer.

fields.label: Opening Shift
fields.description: The shift whose drawer cash was sealed into this bag.

fields.label: Cash Movement
fields.description: The drawer movement that sealed this cash.

fields.label: Dispatch Journal
fields.description: Journal entry that moved the cash from the safe to deposits in transit.

fields.label: Deposit Journal
fields.description: Journal entry that moved the cash from in transit to the bank.

fields.label: Deposit Reference
fields.description: The reference printed on the bank deposit slip.

fields.label: Transferred To Account
fields.description: The off-site cash account the whole bag moved to.

fields.label: Transfer Journal
fields.description: Journal entry of the off-site move.

fields.label: Transferred By
fields.description: Who recorded the off-site move.

fields.label: Transferred On
fields.description: When the off-site move was recorded.

fields.label: Note
fields.description: Handover notes and reasons. They stay in the audit trail.

fields.label: Receipt Movement
fields.description: The drawer movement that received this bag's cash.

fields.label: Receiving Shift
fields.description: The shift whose drawer received this bag.
